facts.text: Audrey made personalized wooden keychains with engraved names for her pets.

evidence.quote: I made these personalized tags for them. Take a look! [image: a photo of a group of wooden keychains with engraved names]
I made them myself. I wanted each one to be special and fit their personalities.

facts.text: Audrey put a lot of love into making the personalized tags for her pets.

evidence.quote: I want my pets to feel seen and loved.
You really put so much love into making them, which makes them extra special.

facts.text: Andrew expressed appreciation for the personalized tags made by Audrey for her pets.

evidence.quote: Wow, those look great! Did you make them? It's really cool!
Wow, that's so cool. You really put so much love into making them, which makes them extra special.

facts.text: Andrew invited Audrey and her pets to join him on a planned hike next month.

evidence.quote: I have plans for a hike next month and thought it'd be cool if you and the pups could come along.
